_comment: Deny rules for the UNATTENDED drain worker only. Loaded per invocation via
--settings, so an operator's own interactive sessions keep their posture: a
global rule would silently restrict work a person is present for.
The worker runs with --permission-mode auto because Stage 4 must be able to
commit and push the catalogs without a human to approve each write. That is
only defensible because the irreversible verbs are denied here. If you edit
this file, you are editing the thing that makes unattended auto-mode safe.
Shape of the rules: prefix match with :* — Bash(git push --force:*) denies
any command line starting with that string. Flag-position and refspec
variants are NOT covered by prefix matching; keep that in mind before
widening what the worker is allowed to do.
